title: Thai food
tagline: Cook it, understand it, and know where to eat it.
subject: Food

items.name: Pailin's Kitchen (formerly Hot Thai Kitchen)
items.why: Le Cordon Bleu-trained Thai chef. Explains the how and why and the cultural context, not just the recipe.

items.name: SheSimmers, by Leela Punyaratabandhu
items.why: Ten years of Thai home-cooking writing (2008–2018). Named best regional cuisine blog by Saveur in 2012.

items.name: Simple Thai Food, by Leela Punyaratabandhu
items.why: 100 classic recipes that make authentic Thai cooking doable at home.

items.name: Bangkok: Recipes and Stories from the Heart of Thailand
items.why: Leela Punyaratabandhu's book that won the 2018 Art of Eating Prize for best food book of the year.

items.name: Leela Punyaratabandhu on Substack
items.why: Her current writing on Thai food, plus recipes.

items.name: Sabai Talk
items.why: Thai cuisine podcast started in 2024 by Pailin Chongchitnant and chef Hong Thaimee.

items.name: Mark Wiens
items.why: Thai street food and restaurant visits, filmed as he eats.

items.name: Eating Thai Food
items.why: Bangkok restaurants, street food and easy recipes.

briefing.headline: Pailin's newest video says UHT carton coconut milk tastes better than canned, and many fans are now looking for it.

points.text: Pailin's Kitchen posted a video on 16 Nov explaining why canned coconut milk tastes worse. She prefers UHT carton coconut milk, especially Aroy-D.
points.label: reported

points.text: She says she has no affiliation with Aroy-D. It is simply her favourite brand.
points.label: reported

points.text: Many fans say carton coconut milk is hard to find in their area. Some say they have found it in international or Asian grocery stores.
points.label: fan view

points.text: Hot Thai Kitchen posted a Thanksgiving-style Thai turkey recipe on 29 Oct, and a Thai-style baked chicken nugget recipe on 9 Nov.
points.label: reported

points.text: Pailin's Fastest Thai Curry video, a panang curry, was posted on 10 Nov.
points.label: reported
